description: This file defines interfaces related to device-to-device file sharing, including ShareTransport for discovery and connection, and PeerSession for managing a session and transferring files.

classes.name: ShareTransport
classes.description: Interface for device-to-device file transfer, handling discovery and data transmission readiness.

classes.name: PeerSession
classes.description: Interface encapsulating an active connection to a peer device, allowing file transfer and connection management.

methods.name: startDiscovery
methods.description: Begins device discovery and connection setup, providing callbacks for success or failure.

methods.name: sendFile
methods.description: Transfers a file identified by a Uri to the connected peer, with progress updates.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the peer connection.
